site.od.tag: Okirikiri abụọ. Otu mpịa. Mwụli ọ bụla n'oge egwu.
site.od.lead: Egwuregwu ụda egwu na mbara igwe dị omimi: otu mpịa na-agbanwe okirikiri, mwụli ọ bụla na-adakwasị n'ụda egwu nke anyị onwe anyị. Ọkwa ise, ọnọdụ Ebighebi, ụzọ bọọlụ iri na otu na ỌNỌDỤ — ndepụta mba gị na nke ụwa.
site.od.new: **ỌNỌDỤ maka onye ọ bụla**: naanị gwuo egwu, ị ga-anọkwa na ndepụta kwa izu — nke mba gị na nke ụwa — ya na ọkọlọtọ gị, bọọlụ gị na ụzọ gị. Asọmpi 4 kwa izu, ihe nrite nkume dị oke ọnụ ahịa kwa Mọnde, na bọọlụ STARDUST na ụzọ FLARE pụrụ iche iji merie. Egwu menu na-aga ugbu a n'onwe ya n'egwu na-esote. N'oge na-adịghị anya na iPhone, egwuregwu ahụ niile na-agbakwa ugbu a n'ihe nchọgharị gị.
site.od.evText_halloween: Ruo 30 Nọvemba, Orbit Dash na-eyi ihe maka Halloween: menu na-aghọ abalị ọnwa nwere ndị amoosu, ụsụ, ntanetị ududo na ugu ndị kandụl na-enye ìhè, bọọlụ gị na-aghọ ugu nwere ụzọ WISP dị ka mmụọ — ha abụọ bụ n'efu maka Halloween — na egwu atọ na-atụ egwu na-abanye n'egwu ahụ. Na 1 Disemba, ihe niile ga-apụ n'onwe ha.

site.more.lead: Egwuregwu njikọ na-eme ka obi dajụọ, egwuregwu ịpị dị ụtọ na ntuziaka mmekọrịta maka ndị na-emepụta egwuregwu — ha niile na Google Play.
site.game.imc.d: Dọrọ. Jikọta. Too. Egwuregwu njikọ idle na-eme ka obi dajụọ, nwere ebumnuche, onyinye kwa ụbọchị na mmụba cube na-enweghị njedebe.
site.game.joints.d: Ntuziaka mmekọrịta maka nkwonkwo Box2D na LibGDX, nwere ihe atụ ndụ, eserese na-emegharị na njikọ bara uru. Onye na-emepụta LibGDX mere ya maka ndị na-emepụta LibGDX.
site.game.light.d: Gwuo ụdị ìhè 2D anọ: ntụpọ, kọn, agbụ na nke nwere ụzọ. Bugharịa ọkụ, mepụta onyinyo ma dozie ntọala ọ bụla.
site.game.autumn.d: Egwuregwu ịpị nke oge mgbụsị akwụkwọ, nwere akwụkwọ na-ada, agba ọkụ, ụda okike ị ga-emepe na ndepụta ndị ndu. Enweghị elekere, enweghị nrụgide: naanị pịa ma zuru ike.

site.p.vlad.bio: Ọ na-ede koodu kemgbe 2017: nke mbụ Java, otu afọ ka e mesịrị Kotlin. Kemgbe 2021 ọ bụ onye na-emepụta egwuregwu oge niile, site na onye na-amụ ọrụ ruo Team Lead n'ụlọ ọrụ egwuregwu. E jiri Kotlin na LibGDX wuo egwuregwu Lewydo ọ bụla, nke mbụ maka Android.
site.p.lilya.who: Liliia, onye nhazi weebụ na UX/UI
site.p.lilya.bio: Websaịtị, nhazi ngosi na eserese maka mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta bụ isi ọrụ ya. N'ihi Vlad, ọ banyekwara na nhazi egwuregwu, egwuregwu Lewydo ọ bụla nwekwara aka ya. *N'etiti anyị: websaịtị ka bụ ịhụnanya mbụ ya* 😉
site.story.title: Akụkọ anyị ruo ugbu a
site.story.1.d: Vlad na-ede koodu mbụ ya. Otu afọ ka e mesịrị ọ gafere na Kotlin ma nọrọ ya ruo mgbe ebighi ebi.
site.story.2.d: Vlad hapụrụ Ụlọ akwụkwọ Agha nke Nzikọrịta ozi wee banye n'egwuregwu oge niile: onye na-amụ ọrụ, junior… ruo Team Lead.
site.story.3.d: Onye na-emepụta zutere onye nhazi. Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ amabeghị na ọ dị.
site.story.4.d: Otu ụbọchị ahụ, ọnwa ọzọ — otu ndị ruo mgbe ebighi ebi.
site.story.brand.d: Vlad na-emechi edemede ya niile na [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) gbasara LibGDX, Android na Kotlin n'otu ụzọ: «Love what you do» na obi akwụkwọ ndụ 💚. Mbinye aka ahụ ghọrọ akara anyị.
site.story.imc.d: IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 pụtara na Google Play.
site.story.idea.d: Vlad na-arụ ọrụ n'Ụsụ Agha Ukraine. Otu ụtụtụ, ọ tetara n'ụlọ ebe otu ndị agha ya nọ n'oge ọrụ — echiche CubePix dị ya n'isi.
site.story.od.d: Anyị mepụtara Orbit Dash ma wepụta ya na Google Play: okirikiri abụọ, otu mpịa.
site.story.proto.d: Ụdị nlele mbụ a pụrụ igwu: ihe osise ama ama na-apụta cube na cube.
site.story.pix.d: Anyị na-emepụta ihe nnọchianya CubePix: obere cube pink, onye na-ese ihe yi okpu beret ma jide brọsh. Aha ya bụ Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, ya mere egwuregwu ahụ na-eburu aha ya.
site.story.l10n.d: Ọrụ kasị ukwuu anyị rụbeghị ugbu a: webụsaịtị studio, webụsaịtị egwuregwu abụọ na egwuregwu ndị ahụ n'onwe ha — CubePix na Orbit Dash — na-amụ asụsụ 82, ka onye ọ bụla nwee ike ịgba egwu n'asụsụ nke ya. Ruo ụbọchị iri na abụọ, a naghị emechi laptọọpụ ahụ ma ọlị. Akaụntụ Claude abụọ rụrụ ọrụ n'akụkụ ibe ha: otu n'ime ha bụ ụlọ ọrụ egwuregwu ebe Vlad bụ Team Lead kwụrụ ($120), nke ọzọ nọ n'ozi ịntanetị Lilya ($120) — mgbe oke izu niile gwụrụ, ọ tolitere gaa na atụmatụ Max ×20 nke $200. Otu akaụntụ jiri GitHub rụọ ihe nlereanya na webụ ozugbo; nke ọzọ kwagara ihe emechara n'egwuregwu Android na iOS n'ezie. Na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, ndị ọrụ ibe Vlad — ndị mmepe Nasuf na Taras — bụ ọmarịcha ụmụ okorobịa; ọ bụ ihe mwute na mgbe Claude Code ghọrọ ike dị otú a, a chụpụrụ ndị ọrụ.
site.story.l10n.d2: N'oge ahụ ka iwu anyị mụrụ: Ihe nlereanya → Egwuregwu, ọ bụghị ọzọ. Ọ dịghị ihe a na-agbanwe n'egwuregwu ozugbo — izizi ihe nlereanya, mgbe ahụ egwuregwu, ya mere ihe niile anyị na-ahụ n'ihe nlereanya bụ nke ahụ kpọmkwem dị n'egwuregwu. Anyị nwere olileanya na ị ga-enwe mmetụta ọdịiche ahụ n'asụsụ gị.
site.story.l10n.photo: Tebụl ahụ n'oge ndị ahụ: laptọọpụ rụrụ ọrụ ụbọchị iri na abụọ n'usoro, ya na ekwentị ule Android na iPhone n'akụkụ ya.
site.story.live.d: Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) na-egwu Orbit Dash na TikTok LIVE — onye streamer mbụ gosiri egwuregwu anyị na ndụ.
site.story.live.video: Andrii na-egwu Orbit Dash na TikTok ndụ
site.story.live.thanks: Daalụ, Andrii, maka ịbụ onye streamer mbụ m mere live ka ọ na-egwu egwuregwu m. Daalụ nke ukwuu!
site.story.web.d: Mgbe mgbasa ozi ozugbo ahụ gasịrị, Vlad na-amalite iwere weebụ dị ka ihe dị mkpa. Ruo oge ahụ, anyị na-eme egwuregwu naanị maka ekwentị — Android na iOS — ụdị weebụ nke Orbit Dash bụkwa naanị demo iji nwee ntakịrị ụtọ egwuregwu ahụ. Ma ndị na-agba mgbasa ozi ozugbo na ndị egwuregwu na-achọ ịgba egwu na kọmputa n'ezie, ya mere Vlad na-ewere ibuga zuru ezu gaa n'ihe nchọgharị.
site.story.web.d2: Ugbu a anyị nwere ikpo okwu ọzọ: Orbit Dash na CubePix bụ egwuregwu zuru ezu na weebụ kwa — enweghị ihe ị ga-etinye, kpọghee ma gwuo.
site.story.web.photo: Orbit Dash na CubePix n'ihe nchọgharị — otu egwuregwu zuru ezu dị ka n'ekwentị.
site.story.sale.d: Otu onye si Italy zụrụ WEPỤ MGBASA OZI na Orbit Dash maka $3.99 — ma $3.03 bịaruru anyị. Dollar mbụ egwuregwu anyị rụpụtara. Grazie mille! 🇮🇹
site.story.ios.d: Nke mbụ, egwuregwu Lewydo ka a na-eziga maka nyocha App Store — Orbit Dash maka iPhone na iPad, ya na asụsụ 82 niile na ỌNỌDỤ. Anyị na-ele anya! 🤞
site.story.next.d: CubePix apụtala na Google Play, Pix abịarakwa ozugbo n'uwe Halloween ya: ụlọ ngosi nka niile na-eme ememe ruo 30 Nọvemba.

brand.rules.title: Hapụ ya ka ọ dị
brand.do.1: Jiri onyonyo na koodu ngwugwu ahụ **ka ha dị**.
brand.do.2: Debe agba, mkpụrụedemede na oke: Lockup bụ **208×322**, mbinye aka bụ **24 + aha**.
brand.do.3: Hapụ obi ka ọ **kụọ otu ugboro** mgbe akara pụtara: ihuenyo mmalite, Banyere anyị (oge ọ bụla e mepere ya), ọgwụ menu.
brand.do.4: Dozie **azụ na ìhè gburugburu** ka ọ dabara egwuregwu gị — logo dị n'elu anaghị agbanwe.
brand.do.5: Tinye ya n'azụ gbara ọchịchịrị (#0E1024 ma ọ bụ abalị gbara ọchịchịrị nke egwuregwu gị).
brand.dont.1: Ise logo ọzọ, ịgbanwe agba ya, ịgbatị ya, ịpịkọta ya, ịtụgharị ya ma ọ bụ ịgbakwunye mmetụta.
brand.dont.2: Ịtụgharị okwu nzuzo ma ọ bụ ide aha ahụ na mkpụrụedemede ọzọ.
brand.dont.3: Ịkụ ya na-akwụsịghị — logo na-egbukepụ mgbe niile na-adọpụ uche n'egwuregwu.
brand.dont.4: Itinye ya n'azụ na-egbuke egbuke ma ọ bụ jupụtara n'ihe.

brand.hb.sub: Obi na ìhè ya na-akụ **nke ọ bụla iche** — «gbim-gbim» ngwa ngwa — naanị **otu ugboro**: mgbe ihuenyo mmalite pụtara, oge ọ bụla e mepere Banyere anyị, mgbe ọgwụ menu pụtara. Ọ dịghị mgbe na-akwụsịghị. Ọ bụrụ na «Belata mmegharị» gbanyere, ọ naghị akụ ma ọlị.

brand.dev.title: Tinye Lewydo n'egwuregwu ọhụrụ
brand.dev.sub: Ihe niile dị n'okpuru dị na [ebe nchekwa websaịtị → brand/](https://github.com/RoShevasternin/roshevasternin.github.io/tree/main/brand) na [brand.json](/brand/brand.json) (nọmba niile, ederede n'asụsụ ọ bụla nke egwuregwu anyị na ụzọ faịlụ — maka koodu na maka Claude).
brand.step.1.d: Depụta `kit/atlas/brand.atlas` + `brand.png` gaa na `assets/atlas/` na `kit/sound/lewydo-heartbeat.wav` gaa na `assets/sound/`; mpaghara atlas: `brand_back`, `brand_front`, `lewydo`, `slogan`, `brand_line` (`assetsBrand` gị, `EnumAtlas.BRAND`).
brand.step.2.d: Depụta `LewydoHeartbeat.kt` (ngwugwu `com.lewydo.brand`) na `BrandScreen.kt`, `ABrandGroup.kt`, `ABrandLogo.kt`; dochie `yourgame` na ngwugwu gị. Ha na-eji ntọala LibGDX nke Lewydo (AdvancedScreen, AConstraintLayout, AAutoLayout).
brand.step.3.d: Malite egwuregwu na `BrandScreen`: ≈ 4 s — logo bịara, ọkụkụ obi na ụda Lewydo, mgbe ahụ `LoaderScreen`. Jikọọ `soundVolume()` na olu ụda egwuregwu gị: 1.0 n'ọkwa ya nkịtị, dị ala naanị ma ọ bụrụ na onye egwuregwu belatara ya.
brand.step.4.d: Ọgwụ n'okpuru menu (n'etiti, 34 px site n'ala) → Banyere anyị; otu ọkụkụ mgbe menu pụtara.
brand.step.5.d: Lockup n'elu na 108, ederede ụlọ ọrụ (Bekee bụ ihe ntụaka; asụsụ ọ bụla nke egwuregwu anyị dị na brand.json), «Websaịtị anyị» → `https://roshevasternin.github.io/` na adreesị n'okpuru ya, «Egwuregwu anyị na Google Play» → peeji onye na-emepụta anyị, «© 2026 Lewydo™». Otu ọkụkụ oge ọ bụla e mepere ya.
brand.step.6.d: Dozie azụ na ìhè dị n'azụ logo ka ọ dabara egwuregwu gị — ọ dịghị mgbe logo n'onwe ya.
brand.prompt: Maka Claude n'ọrụ ọzọ — depụta nke a (Claude na-agụ ya n'asụsụ Bekee)
brand.foot: © 2026 Lewydo™ · Love What You Do. Logo Lewydo bụ nke anyị: jiri ya naanị n'ọrụ Lewydo, na naanị ka ngwugwu a si gosi.
brand.hb.finale: N'ihuenyo mmalite, ọkụkụ obi bụ **njedebe**: nke mbụ logo niile bịara, mgbe ahụ iku ume, «gbim» siri ike na «gbim» ọzọ, ebili mmiri ìhè abụọ — na ụda Lewydo.
brand.snd.title: Ụda Lewydo
brand.snd.sub: Naanị obi: ọkụkụ abụọ dị nro, gbara okirikiri — nke mbụ siri ike, nke abụọ dị jụụ — ya na ọkụkụ logo n'otu oge. Enweghị egwu, enweghị mgbịrịgba: ekele dị jụụ ma dị ọkụ.
brand.snd.r1: Otu ugboro na mmalite ọ bụla, ya na ihuenyo mmalite — ọ dịghị mgbe na-akwụsịghị.
brand.snd.r2: N'olu zuru oke mgbe ụda egwuregwu dị n'ọkwa nkịtị (mbuli 1.0); ihe ịkpụgharị onye egwuregwu nwere ike ibelata ya naanị; ụda gbanyụrụ — ịgbachi nkịtị.
brand.snd.r3: Agbanwela ya, ebipụla ya, ma ọ bụ kpọọ ya n'okpuru egwu.
brand.snd.r4: Peeji weebụ nwere ike ịkpọ ya naanị mgbe mpịa gachara; ihuenyo mmalite na-amalite n'onwe ya na-anọ jụụ.
brand.snd.r5: Otu faịlụ ebe niile: `lewydo-heartbeat.wav` — egwuregwu ọ bụla, ụdị nlele weebụ ya na websaịtị ya na-akpọ otu faịlụ a, byte na byte. Enweghị mfu ịdị mma (16-bit PCM, 48 kHz, stereo) ma e mere ya maka ekwe okwu ekwentị (ụda nke ya, ọnụ ọnụ na −1 dBFS) — ka Lewydo na-ada otu ụdị ebe ọ bụla ị nụrụ ya.
brand.say.note: «Lewydo» bụ «Love What You Do» a kpọrọ ngwa ngwa: mkpụrụokwu atọ, **Lev-wai-du**.
brand.c.sound.d: Ọkụkụ obi — otu .wav na-enweghị mfu ịdị mma maka egwuregwu, ụdị nlele weebụ na websaịtị. Enweghị nnomi .ogg ma ọ bụ .mp3: ngwaọrụ ọ bụla ga-agụpụta ha ntakịrị n'ụzọ dị iche.
brand.dont.5: Ịkpọ ụda na-akwụsịghị, karịa egwuregwu, ma ọ bụ mgbe onye egwuregwu gbanyụrụ ụda.
brand.work.title: Ụdị nlele na mbụ, mgbe ahụ egwuregwu
brand.work.lead: Otu a ka e si eme egwuregwu Lewydo ọ bụla.
brand.work.1: **Ihe ọhụrụ niile na-amalite n'ụdị nlele.** Ihuenyo, usoro egwuregwu, ederede ma ọ bụ nọmba ka a na-ebu ụzọ mee ma nwalee n'ụdị nlele weebụ nke egwuregwu ahụ — ịnwale na ihe nchọgharị dị ngwa.
brand.work.2: **A na-ebufe egwuregwu ahụ site na ya.** Egwuregwu ahụ (LibGDX: Android, emesịa iOS) na-ewe ihe niile site n'ụdị nlele, nọmba na okwu otu ụdị ahụ: ụdị nlele bụ ihe ntụaka.
brand.work.3: **Ọ dịghị mgbe ọzọ.** Ihe ọhụrụ e mere naanị n'ime egwuregwu, ụdị nlele amaghị ya, ha abụọ ewee kewaa. Ọbụna ndozi: nke mbụ n'ụdị nlele, mgbe ahụ n'egwuregwu.
